title: 第7章 你买的不是丹药是光明的未来啊第8章 原来我的背景这么吊
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
钱多多呆立在原地，怀疑自己的耳朵是不是出了问题。
他来之前，是做过功课的。
市面上流通的普通金刚丹，价格在八到十块下品灵石。
就算是上品，也就十五到二十块灵石。
这……这翻了几乎十倍啊！
抢钱也不是这么抢的！
“李、李师兄……”
钱多多的声音都有些发颤，他小心翼翼地组织着措辞：“您这价格，是不是有点……太高了？”
“高？”
李玄眉毛一挑，仿佛听到了什么天大的笑话。
他拍了拍钱多多的肩膀，语重心长地说道：“钱师弟，你可不能把它当成普通的金刚丹啊！”
“你想想，买一枚这个，你得到的是什么？”
“那可是一个能打能抗的练气大圆满保镖！”
“而且，你还能通过它积累宝贵的战斗经验，这可比在幻境里模拟对战真实多了！”
李玄循循善诱，声音里充满了蛊惑人心的力量：
“我再问你，在宗门里，你想请一个练气大圆满，随时都能召唤出来的保镖师兄，得多少灵石？”
“一百块，够吗？”
“绝对不够！”
“更何况，我这召唤出来的，可是妖族！”
妖族肉身天生强悍。

练气期乃是修行之初始，修士还没掌握多少厉害法术，无法操纵强力法宝。
同阶对战，普遍要弱于妖族。
只有那些真正的天才，才能稳压妖族一头。
“你再想想，你买这丹药，是为了什么？”
李玄的目光变得锐利起来：“肯定是为了在这次宗门大比上，夺一个好名次，顺利跻身内门弟子，对不对？”
“如今的宗门大比，除了大师姐那寥寥几个亲传弟子之外，有几个弟子是练气大圆满？”
“你有了金刚相助，那还不是神挡杀神，佛挡杀佛？”
“你买的不是丹药，是光明的未来啊！”
“区区一百灵石，钱师弟，你自己说，这笔买卖，值不值？”
“大声回答我，值不值！？”
钱多多被他的声音吓的一激灵，下意识地开口：“值！”
李玄大手一挥：“声音太小了，再大声点。”
content_en:
Qian Duoduo stood there blankly, wondering if there was something wrong with his ears.
Before he came, he had done his homework.
The price of ordinary vajra pills circulating in the market is eight to ten yuan for low-grade spiritual stones.
Even if it is a high-grade one, it only costs fifteen to twenty spiritual stones.
This...this has doubled almost ten times!
That’s not how you steal money!
"Li, senior brother Li..."
Qian Duoduo's voice was trembling a little, and he carefully organized his words: "Is your price a bit... too high?"
"High?"
Li Xuan raised his eyebrows, as if he had heard some big joke.
He patted Qian Duoduo on the shoulder and said earnestly: "Junior brother Qian, you can't treat it as an ordinary vajra pill!"
"Think about it, if you buy one of these, what do you get?"
"That's a Qi-training Dzogchen bodyguard who can fight and resist!"
"Moreover, you can also accumulate valuable combat experience through it, which is much more real than simulating battles in a fantasy world!"
Li Xuan was good at tempting, and his voice was full of the power to confuse people:
"Let me ask you again, in the sect, if you want to hire a bodyguard brother who can practice Qi Dzogchen and can be summoned at any time, how many spiritual stones will you get?"
"One hundred yuan, is that enough?"
"Absolutely not enough!"
"What's more, the one I summoned is a demon!"
The demon race's physical body is naturally strong.
The Qi training period is the beginning of cultivation. The monks have not yet mastered many powerful spells and cannot control powerful magic weapons.
When fighting at the same level, they are generally weaker than the demon clan.
Only those true geniuses can stabilize the demon clan.
"Think about it again, why did you buy this elixir?"
Li Xuan's eyes became sharp: "It must be to get a good ranking in this sect competition and successfully become an inner disciple, right?"
"In today's sect competition, apart from the few direct disciples of Senior Sister, how many disciples are practicing Qi Dzogchen?"
"If you have Vajra to help you, doesn't it mean that God will kill God if he blocks it, and Buddha will kill Buddha if he blocks Buddha?"
"What you bought is not a pill, but a bright future!"
"A mere hundred spirit stones, Junior Brother Qian, tell yourself, is this deal worth it?"
"Answer me loudly, is it worth it!?"
Qian Duoduo was frightened by his voice and subconsciously said: "It's worth it!"
Li Xuan waved his hand: "The voice is too low, please speak louder."
